001package net.tnemc.item.platform.conversion;
002
003import java.util.HashMap;
004import java.util.Comparator;
005import java.util.List;
006import java.util.Map;
007import java.util.Objects;
008import java.util.function.Function;
009
010public class PlatformConverter {
011
012  private final Map<Class<?>, Map<Class<?>, Function<Object, Object>>> registry = new HashMap<>();
013
014  public <Input, Output> void registerConversion(final Class<Input> inputClass, final Class<Output> outputClass,
015                                                final Function<Input, Output> converter) {
016
017    Objects.requireNonNull(inputClass, "inputClass");
018    Objects.requireNonNull(outputClass, "outputClass");
019    Objects.requireNonNull(converter, "converter");
020    registry.computeIfAbsent(inputClass, ignored -> new HashMap<>())
021            .put(outputClass, input -> converter.apply(inputClass.cast(input)));
022  }
023
024  public <Input, Output> Output convert(final Input input, final Class<Output> outputClass) {
025
026    if(input == null) {
027      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Input cannot be null");
028    }
029    Objects.requireNonNull(outputClass, "outputClass");
030    final Function<Object, Object> converter = conversion(input.getClass(), outputClass);
031    if(converter != null) {
032      return outputClass.cast(converter.apply(input));
033    }
034    if(outputClass.isInstance(input)) {
035      return outputClass.cast(input);
036    }
037    throw new IllegalArgumentException("No conversion registered from " + input.getClass().getName()
038                                       + " to " + outputClass.getName());
039  }
040
041  private Function<Object, Object> conversion(final Class<?> inputClass, final Class<?> outputClass) {
042
043    final Function<Object, Object> exact = registry.getOrDefault(inputClass, Map.of()).get(outputClass);
044    if(exact != null) {
045      return exact;
046    }
047    final List<Class<?>> candidates = registry.keySet().stream()
048            .filter(candidate -> candidate.isAssignableFrom(inputClass) && registry.get(candidate).containsKey(outputClass))
049            .toList();
050    return candidates.stream()
051            .filter(candidate -> candidates.stream().noneMatch(other -> candidate != other && candidate.isAssignableFrom(other)))
052            .min(Comparator.comparing(Class::getName))
053            .map(candidate -> registry.get(candidate).get(outputClass))
054            .orElse(null);
055  }
056}
